about_the_game:
Sound of Horses is a story-driven, multi-part horseback adventure told across several episodes.

Your journey begins in the peaceful land of Homeland and slowly leads into something deeper.

Create your own rider and horse, explore open landscapes filled with everyday life and quiet mysteries, meet memorable characters, and take on challenges that shape the early steps of your story.

What’s included in Episode 1

Episode 1 introduces the world of Sound of Horses and tells a complete opening chapter of the story, where everyday life on horseback gradually leads into the first unfolding mystery.

It offers approximately 6–7 hours of story-driven gameplay, with additional time for exploration depending on playstyle.

About future episodes

Each new episode continues the story and expands the world, and will be released as a separate paid DLC, priced at approximately $6.99 USD per episode (with launch discounts during Early Access).

A complete bundle including all episodes will be available later, planned at around $25 USD.

Episodes 2–4 will become available over time during Early Access.

The journey ahead

Starting with Episode 2: The Forest Guard, the story begins to cross into the Other Side—a parallel world shaped by forgotten secrets and ancient forces.

From that point on, your journey will move between two worlds:
the familiar routines of Homeland, and the strange, shifting paths of what lies beyond.

Even as you’re drawn deeper into the unknown, life in Homeland continues—asking for your time, your choices, and your care.

Along the way, you’ll discover the unique horse cultures of each region, each with their own traditions, breeds, and competitions.

Planned story episodes

Episode 1 – Homeland
Begin your story in the quiet Homeland, where everyday life on horseback slowly gives way to something unexpected.

Episode 2 – The Forest Guard (planned DLC, sold separately)
Journey through deep forests and snow-covered mountains, uncovering the way of the Forest Guards and the secrets they protect.

Episode 3 – The Mystery of Draconia (planned DLC, sold separately)
Solve ancient riddles and take part in legendary competitions in a land shaped by old myths.

Episode 4 – The Land of the Eagle (planned DLC, sold separately)
Train with the people of the Steppe and face a final test of strength, trust, and skill against the legendary Eagle.

With a strong focus on storytelling, atmosphere, and a meaningful riding experience, Sound of Horses invites players of all ages to step into a gentle but growing adventure—one episode at a time.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Athlon II (K10) 2.8 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Athlon II (K10) 2.8 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 660, Intel Iris Xe, or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card
